refusal.message: the built-in additive model does not fit the 'binomial' likelihood directly: its component priors are calibrated for standardized-Normal y on an identity link. A model that needs a 'binomial' observation must define its own observation block — override `_build_model` (subclass `mmm_framework.garden.CustomMMM`) and write the likelihood there, reading `self.model_config.likelihood` and `self.model_params`. See technical-docs/custom-model-config.md.
